domain.description: The domain to connect to. If a domain is not specified, then the domain part of the local computer's host name is used.

domain_controller.description: Connect to a specific domain controller (equivalent to --domain-controller). If not specified, then an appropriate domain controller is automatically discovered.

domain_realm.description: Kerberos realm for the domain (equivalent to --domain-realm). If not specified, then the upper cased domain name is used.

login_user.description: Use the specified user account to authenticate with the domain (equivalent to --login-user). If not specified, then the name 'Administrator' will be used.

computer_name.description: The short non-dotted name of the computer account that will be created in the domain (equivalent to --computer-name). If not specified, then the first portion of the --host-fqdn is used.

domain_ou.description: The full distinguished name of the OU in which to create the computer account (equivalent to --domain-ou). If not specified, then the computer account will be created in a default location.

host_fqdn.description: Override the local machine's fully qualified domain name (equivalent to --host-fqdn). If not specified, the local machine's hostname will be retrieved via gethostname().

host_keytab.description: Specify the path to the host keytab where host credentials will be written after a successful join operation (equivalent to --host-keytab). If not specified, the default location will be used, usually /etc/krb5.keytab.

use_ldaps.description: Connect to the domain controller with LDAPS (equivalent to --use-ldaps). By default the LDAP port is used.

verbose.description: Run in verbose mode with debug output (equivalent to --verbose).
